source.notes:
Archive containing the definition document and modelling files of package WP2.2 from the OC7 project Phase II.

The following files are included:

.\01_DEF
FE_Output_for_comparison_REV2.pdf: Illustrating panels and cross sections relevant for pressure/stress/load reporting.
OC7_WP2p2_ColumnAxialDrag.xlsx: Calculation sheet for drag coefficient for column end plates (based on column bottom area).
OC7_WP2p2_Description_REV12.xlsx: Description document covering information on the model and load cases.

.\02_CAD
Full assembly updated.igs: Floater hull geometry in IGS format.
Full assembly updated.scdoc: Floater hull geometry in SpaceClaim format.
Full assembly updated.stp: Floater hull geometry in STEP format.

.\03_FE
ANSYS_FE_MODEL.zip: Model for Ansys Workbench (floater only)
ANSYS_FE_MODEL_Subs+tower+RNA.zip: Model for Ansys Workbench (floater, tower and RNA)
OC7_FE_MODEL_Subs+tower+RNA.dat: Mesh in Ansys format (floater, tower and RNA)
OC7_FE_MODEL_Subs+tower+RNA_modal.bdf: Mesh in Nastran format (floater, tower and RNA)
OC7_FE_MODEL_v3.dat: Mesh in Ansys format (floater only).
OC7_FE_MODEL_v3_modal.bdf: Mesh in Nastran format (floater only).

.\04_OF
OrcaFlex_Example_LC7p3.dat: OrcaFlex example model for load case LC7.3.
UMaineSemi_SB.GDF: Body mesh file for OrcaWave
UMaineSemi_SB.owd: OrcaWave model file (single body)
UMaineSemi_SB.owr: Results file from OrcaWave calculation (single body)

The results are archived separately [https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21222818].
source.title: OC7 Project Phase II: Definition Document and Modelling Files for WP2.2 on Global-to-Local Load Transfer Approaches in Floating Structures
